Job Position: Secretary

Working days: Monday -Saturday
Work Hours: 9:00am to 5:30pm

Description


	As the Company Secretary, you will be the first point of contact for our walk in clients, corporate partners, and service technicians.
	You will manage the daily administrative operations of the office, ensure inquiries are handled professionally, and provide vital support to the sales and technical teams so they can focus on closing deals and completing installations.


Core Responsibilities


	Front Desk Management: Greet and assist walk-in clients, vendors, and partners with a warm and professional demeanor.
	Customer Communication: Manage incoming phone calls, emails, and social media inquiries. Provide basic product information and route technical or sales queries to the appropriate departments.
	Administrative Support: Draft letters, memos, and invoices. Maintain an organized filing system for client contracts, warranties, and service schedules.
	Sales &amp; Service Coordination: Assist the sales team in logging new leads and help the technical team schedule installation and maintenance appointments.
	Office Operations: Ensure the reception and general office areas are clean, professional, and well-stocked with necessary office supplies.


Requirements &amp; Qualifications


	Education: Minimum of OND or BSc in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies, or a related field.
	Experience: 1&ndash;3 years of proven experience as a Secretary, Front Desk Executive, or Administrative Assistant. (Experience in the energy, tech, or sales sector is a strong advantage).
	Tech-Savvy: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comfortable using email and basic CRM tools.
	Communication Skills: Excellent spoken and written English. You must be able to communicate clearly and politely with a diverse range of clients.
	Organization: Strong multitasking skills with an eye for detail.
	Proximity: Due to the 6-day work week and working hours, candidates residing in or very close to Wuse 2are strongly preferred.


What We Offer


	Salary: N100,000 - N130,000 per month.
	Stability: A secure role in one of the fastest-growing industries in Nigeria.
	Growth: Opportunity to learn about the lucrative renewable energy market and grow alongside a company dedicated to empowering its people.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their &nbsp;Updated CV and a brief introductory email to: applywithmishra@gmail.com using &quot;Secretary Abuja&rdquo; as the subject of the email.",

Employment Type: Full-time
Working days: Monday -Saturday
Work Hours: 9:00am to 5:30pm

Description
     

            
    




	As the Company Secretary, you will be the first point of contact for our walk in clients, corporate partners, and service technicians.

Front Desk Officer Job at Deutsche Partners Holding Limited




        
    

        
        Deutsche Partners Holding Limited (DPH) is a leading financial services and investment firm with core expertise in Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Securities, and Trusteeship Services. We are committed to delivering innovative financial solutions, creating sustainable investment opportunities, and providing exceptional advisory services that enable our clients to achieve their strategic and financial objectives.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Front Desk Officer
Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Position Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly organized, courteous, and technology-driven Front Desk Officer to manage our reception area and provide exceptional administrative and customer service support.
	The successful candidate will serve as the Company's first point of contact, ensuring every visitor and caller receives a professional, efficient, and welcoming experience while supporting administrative operations across the organization.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage visitor registration, access control, and visitor logs in accordance with Company procedures.
	Respond to general enquiries and provide accurate information regarding the Company's services.
	Maintain accurate electronic records and update administrative databases.
	Coordinate incoming and outgoing correspondence, courier services, and document distribution.
	Assist with virtual meeting coordination using platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or Google Meet


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor's Degree or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Public Administration, Office Technology and Management, Human Resources, or a related discipline.
	2–4 years of relevant experience in a front desk, receptionist, customer service, or administrative support role.
	Experience within a financial services, consulting, professional services, or corporate environment will be an added advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their an updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) and cover letter highlighting their suitability for the role to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Job Position: Administrative Assistant

Summary Of Key Functions / accountabilities


	Communications & Workflow
	Calendar/Meetings/Correspondence Management
	Events/Logistics
	Travel Assistance
	Invoice Processing
	Supplies/Equipment
	Attendance Monitoring.


Minimum Requirements


	Education: Completion of secondary education is required, preferably supplemented by technical or university courses related to the field of work.
	Work Experience: A minimum of 4 years of relevant administrative or clerical work experience is required.

Project Management:


	Use project management tools to organize and track tasks within a project
	Schedule and prioritize tasks to meet deadlines
	Provide project updates and report issues


Collaboration:


	Use tact and discretion in sensitive situations
	Communicate thoughtfully and diplomatically considering how words may be perceived by others
	Write clearly and concisely in emails and reports, outlining brief summaries and suggested actions

	Compare different sets of information to identify correlations and differences

        NHC Pharmaceuticals Limited is a Pharma wholesales distribution company that is dedicated to empowering healthcare providers by bridging supply gaps. With branches across multiple states in Western Nigeria, we ensure that pharmacies, hospitals and other healthcare institutions have access to essential healthcare products through reliable and efficient service. We are more than just a supplier; we’re a trusted partner, helping healthcare providers meet their patients’ needs with confidence.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales Manager
Job Location: Ogba, Lagos 

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Lead and manage the sales team
	Develop strategies to drive revenue growth
	Build and maintain strong client relationships.


Requirements


	Degree in Marketing, Business or related fields
	Proven sales experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
